descriptor: Analytics dashboard for goals and metrics

voice.summary: Neuralyn writes like a data lead in a dark room: calm, exact and short on hype. It sets one clear overview above many numbers and uses one italic word for emphasis.
dos: Lead with the single clear overview
Use italic for one word only
donts: Do not say 'AI-powered' without saying what it does
Do not use stock chart language

taglines: Metrics, goals and progress in view
Track what matters, ignore the rest
boilerplate: Neuralyn is an analytics dashboard that helps teams track metrics, goals and progress with precision in a single clear overview.

microcopy.success: Dashboard ready. Your first metrics are loading.
microcopy.error: We could not connect that source. Check your key.
microcopy.empty: No metrics yet. Connect a data source.

logo.note: A spark suggests insight at the centre of the dashboard.
